Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the discovery earlier this week — the team found the call really helpful. We'd like to move into a short hands-on sandbox session to validate inference latency, KV-cache behavior with our prompt patterns, and model fallback behavior. Ideally we'd run a 90-minute session with your engineers (runtime + integration) and our DevOps team.

High-level asks: 
- Walkthrough of how Redwood routing would handle our regional constraints
- Run 2 short load patterns (inference + burst) against a staging model
- Confirm telemetry we can expect in the Console (latency, per-route cost)

Could you propose 2-3 windows next week (PST) that work for your team? We'll share a small set of test prompts and a short spreadsheet of expected traffic patterns.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.
